LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TheirSchemes: Those with a grudge may send one of theirs to break a machine, steal, stir up a fight or gather tales.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TheirSchemes_Tip: How often a scheme against the colony begins. At 100% (the default), a home with a people within reach that holds a grudge against it (and is at peace with it), or a notable who thinks -40 or less of it, has a chance of 8% each day once a season has passed since its last scheme began: about two a year, at most one a season. A scheme is acted out only while one of theirs is on the map (a visitor, or a guard of a trader's caravan) and is given up after a season. Caught by a colonist awake, a guard on duty or a dog, the one at it leaves at once and their people remember it. 200% doubles the chance; 0% switches schemes off. Needs answers on the map.
